title: Meridian Motorworks — Exotic & Collector Cars
body_text: Meridian Motorworks sells and consigns exotic and collector automobiles from our showroom in Scottsdale, Arizona. Current inventory spans low-mileage modern supercars and investment-grade classics, with a rotating weekly featured vehicle. We offer white-glove nationwide enclosed transport and pre-purchase inspections. Typical listing prices range from $120,000 to well over $1,000,000. Contact our sales desk at sales@example-motors.test or 480-555-0142. We speak plainly and let the machinery do the talking.
